modernopt.config.title: ModernOPT
modernopt.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for all ModernOPT render changes. Turning it off restores the game's own rendering exactly.
modernopt.option.disable.tooltip: Fully disables ModernOPT: no target swap, no upscaling and no shadow changes until it is enabled again.
modernopt.option.shadowUpdateInterval.to: Average number of frames per shadow rebuild. 1 is the normal behaviour; 1.5 alternates two draws and one skip, 2 skips every other frame, up to 8. The held matrix is anchored to the drawn frame and moved with the camera so shadows stay attached.
modernopt.option.renderScale.tooltip: Internal world resolution. Lower values render fewer pixels and upscale the result.
modernopt.option.dynamicMovingResolution: While the camera moves or looks around, multiply the internal resolution by 0.85 and round to the nearest percent (70% -> 60%). Restores after the camera has been still for a moment.
modernopt.option.upscaler.tooltip: Filter used to reconstruct the full-resolution image. MSR adds temporal accumulation and works with Iris shader packs; MSAA is forced off.
modernopt.option.shadowMapResolution.too: Absolute shadow map resolution for Iris shader packs (512/1024/2048/4096). Independent of the render scale; changing it reloads the pack once.
modernopt.option.softness.tooltip: SoftScale blur strength: 0 is neutral, 100 is very soft.
modernopt.option.fsrEasuSharpness.toolti: EASU sharpening strength for FSR 1 and MSR: 0 is off, 100 is strong. Controls edge enhancement during upscaling.
modernopt.option.fsrRcasSharpness.toolti: RCAS sharpening strength for FSR 1 and MSR: 0 is off, 100 is strong. Applied after upscaling/temporal pass.
modernopt.option.msaa.tooltip: Multisample anti-aliasing for the world pass. Ignored while a shader pack is active.
modernopt.option.ssaa.tooltip: Render the world at 2x resolution and downsample. Overrides render scale and MSAA.
modernopt.option.fxaa.tooltip: Post-process edge smoothing on the final image.
modernopt.option.overlay.tooltip: Show FPS and the current internal resolution.
modernopt.option.fp16.tooltip: Render the pre-upscale image into a 16-bit float buffer (less banding, more bandwidth).
modernopt.option.logFps.tooltip: Write FPS statistics to the log every second.
modernopt.option.msrLanczos.tooltip: Use Lanczos-2 for FSR 1 and MSR and inside MSR2. Bilinear, Nearest and Soft keep their own kernel.
modernopt.option.msrLanczos3.tooltip: Use the wider Lanczos-3 kernel for FSR 1, MSR and MSR2.
modernopt.option.msrEnabled.tooltip: Legacy option. Select MSR2 in the upscaler list instead.
modernopt.option.msrVarianceScale.toolti: Variance clipping threshold for temporal pass. Higher = more aggressive history rejection. Default 2.0x.
modernopt.option.msrEdgeAware.tooltip: Enable edge-aware interpolation in spatial pass to preserve geometry edges.
modernopt.option.msrSharpness.tooltip: MSR2 spatial sharpening (CAS) strength: 0 = off, 100 = strong.
modernopt.option.msrDepthThreshold.toolt: Depth difference threshold for temporal disocclusion detection. Default 0.02.
modernopt.option.msrHistoryWeight.toolti: Base history blend weight for temporal accumulation. Default 0.85.
modernopt.sodium.open.tooltip: Render scale, upscaling, MSAA, FXAA and SSAA
